name: How do I choose a real estate agent to sell an inherited property?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a real estate agent to sell an inherited property?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a real estate agent for an inherited property, look for someone with experience in probate sales and a strong understanding of the local market. The agent should be empathetic to your situation, provide clear communication, and have a proven marketing strategy. Kelby Contreras, serving areas like Boca Raton and West Palm Beach, brings extensive local market knowledge and a network of professionals to assist with inherited property sales, offering guidance throughout the process to ensure a thoughtful and effective sale.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an agent experienced in probate sales, with local market knowledge and strong communication skills. They should understand the unique aspects of inherited properties.
